figurative_meaning_en: Symbol of mature wisdom and experience
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি এই কাজে পাকা হাড়, কোনো ভুল করবেন না।
জীবনের অভিজ্ঞতা তাকে পাকা হাড় করে তুলেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is an old hand at this job; he won't make any mistakes.
Life's experiences have made him a seasoned veteran.
note: The idiom uses the metaphor of 'mature bones' to imply strength gained through age and experience, common in oral Bengali traditions.
